selection_reason:
Verify ordered source routes and their affected consumers.

The new route regression retains all 102 original conditions, adds 32 successor
choice observations, checks all eight states of each of 11 branches, governing
capture changes, exact native edge transport and the erased null Unit literal.
The historical 81-condition test, capture compatibility, typed observations and
three scope units cover unchanged APIs, producer premises and binder limits.
Clippy and format cover the changed library/test code. Unaffected parser, scalar,
codec and unrelated application tests are not repeated. The full T06 gate is
still deferred to T06-W12; no application proof is claimed by these checks.
